reference.title: Scenario 7 — Image inside a table cell

section.p: Consider a table where the author has inserted an inline image directly into a table cell — for example, a status icon or a screenshot thumbnail. The image must be set to In Line with Text wrapping.

row.entry: │ Status │ Icon │ Description │ │ OK │ [inline: ok_icon.png] │ System running │ │ Error │ [inline: err_icon.png] │ Error detected │

entry.codeblock: <reference id="status_icon_descriptions"> <title>Status Icon Descriptions</title> <refbody> <simpletable> <sthead> <stentry>Status</stentry> <stentry>Icon</stentry> <stentry>Description</stentry> </sthead> <strow> <stentry>OK</stentry> <stentry> <image href="media/ok_icon.png" placement="inline"/> </stentry> <stentry>System running.</stentry> </strow> <strow> <stentry>Error</stentry> <stentry> <image href="media/err_icon.png" placement="inline"/> </stentry> <stentry>Error detected.</stentry> </strow> </simpletable> </refbody> </reference>

section.p: Result:Inline images in table cells are extracted and mapped to <image placement="inline"/> inside the <stentry>. For more information on images, see Images and Graphics.
